title: Find next (f3) match line behind find bar
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: - v4.7.dev2.official - v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e] ### System information Godot v4.7.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory ### Issue description The find next (f3) match line is hidden by the find bar, when the match line is at the bottom of the script editor, and the find bar was closed before pressing `f3`. Expected: Show the match line above the find bar. A possible fix: Show the find bar before scrolling to the match line. A workaround is to show the find bar (`ctrl + f`), before pressing `f3`. ### Steps to reproduce open the project: `issue-find-next-(f-3)-match-line-behind-find-bar.zip` open `new_script.gd` click on the scripts first line: `extends Node` press: `ctrl + f` to open the find bar type: `abc` press: `esc` to close the find bar press: `f3` (find next) Issue: In v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e] the whole match line is hidden by the find bar: In v4.7.dev2.official [778cf54da] the bottom half of the match line is hidden by the find bar: Expected: The match line is above the find bar. This already happens when the find bar is open before pressing `f3` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [issue-find-next-(f-3)-match-line-behind-find-bar.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25771468/issue-find-next-.f-3.-match-line-behind-find-bar.zip)
